Cache is memory located within the microprocessor that is very fast. This memory is used as a scratch pad where the processor can store and retrieve information quickly.

This cache is used only for instructions and not for data. Other features include: 11 data and 11 address registers; 3 stack pointers, and the CAAR and CACR 32-bit registers. These registers are used to deal with the internal cache.
The 68030 includes a on-board memory management unit and the ability to interface with a floating point co-processor, also known as a FPC.
